cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(OpenSteamToolHookTests LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT MSVC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "These hook tests require Windows MSVC (SEH and x64 hooks)")
endif()
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(OST_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../build/generated" CACHE PATH
    "Headers generated by configuring the core with cmake -S src -B build")
if(NOT EXISTS "${OST_GENERATED_DIR}/ost_log_macros.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Configure the core first, or set OST_GENERATED_DIR to its generated headers")
endif()
add_executable(license_readiness_test "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/license_readiness_test.cpp")
target_include_directories(license_readiness_test PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../src" "${OST_GENERATED_DIR}")
target_compile_options(license_readiness_test PRIVATE /utf-8)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME license_readiness COMMAND license_readiness_test)
